source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Uses of Computer Network' (PDF 7): the same text in simple Roman Urdu with glossed hard words, a self-check and a recap.

blocks.text: Internet browsing (websites dekhna) network ke istemal ki aam misaal hai. Mobile phones calls, messages aur apps ke liye networks istemal karte hain. Schools online classes aur learning systems (parhai ke online platforms, jaise LMS) ke liye networks istemal karte hain. Banks online transactions (paise ka len-den) aur ATMs ke liye networks istemal karte hain. Social media platforms computer networks ke zariye chalte hain. Smart homes (aise ghar jin ki cheezein mobile se chalti hain) bhi devices control karne ke liye networks istemal karte hain.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Jab aap ATM se paise nikalte hain to ATM network ke zariye bank ke computer se poochta hai ke account mein kitne paise hain. Network na ho to ATM kaam nahi kar sakta.

blocks.prompt: Computer network ke koi do istemal likhein.
blocks.explanation: Maslan: online banking aur ATM; schools mein online classes. (Internet browsing, mobile calls aur messages, social media aur smart homes bhi sahi jawab hain.)

items: Istemal: browsing, mobile calls/messages/apps, online classes, banking aur ATM, social media, smart homes.
